integrity: All new proof steps checked directly. Elementary collapse algorithm and independent finite mod-two checks replayed from embedded standalone Python script; finite checks do not replace all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: Only synchronous binary sandpiles on right-directed paths with a terminal sink, two adjacent grain pairs separated by at least one zero, and arbitrary trailing zeros. No claim about all binary configurations, cycles, other firing rules, or persistence. Unindexed equivalent prior work remains possible.
title: Two separated grain-pairs give a circle in directed-path avalanche topology
